name: Set
cue: Hold the bar over your chest with arms extended.

name: Lower
cue: Lower under control, keeping wrists stacked.

name: Floor contact
cue: Let your upper arms meet the floor.

name: Pause
cue: Pause on the floor without bouncing.

name: Press
cue: Drive the bar upward while keeping your feet planted.

name: Reset
cue: Finish with arms extended, ready for the next repetition.
